reviewMethod: Independent static re-review of binary-derived exports against final-iteration Core/Web/SQL source. Runtime tests are recorded separately and are not inferred from source inspection.

findings.trigger: Update only phone_number on an existing student.

source.behavior: Only changed draft keys plus row_version, updated_at and updated_by are logged; CREATE includes derived/fixed category and creation columns.

target.behavior: ChangedStudentColumns includes only changed stored draft/derived values, generated fixed/creation columns on CREATE and relationship_category on nullability transition.

findings.requiredCorrection: Compute changed_columns from actual changed stored values; include generated fields on CREATE and relationship_category when it changes. Add phone-only edit and CREATE audit regression.
findings.originalObservedBehavior: name_key and kana_key unconditionally included in UPDATE; fixed category/creation fields omitted in CREATE.
resolutionEvidence: Core.Tests phone-only and CREATE audit regression
Sql.Tests persisted phone-only and CREATE audit regression

findings.trigger: Change only a master name while leaving other fields unchanged.

source.behavior: Master audit includes actual changed keys plus row_version, updated_at, updated_by.

target.behavior: ChangedClassColumns/ChangedCodeColumns compare original/current values and retain row_version/updated_at/updated_by metadata.

findings.requiredCorrection: Compute master changed-column list from actual before/after values and preserve create/update/enable/disable operation. Add name-only edit regression.
findings.originalObservedBehavior: MaintainClass and MaintainCode construct fixed arrays containing every editable column.

findings.trigger: Display birth date in the student search list.

source.behavior: FormatBirthDate produces Japanese era label, first year 元, and month/day display.

target.behavior: JapaneseDate.FormatBirthDate matches source era labels, first-year 元 and zero-padded month/day; controller uses it for search and duplicate-confirmation rows.

findings.requiredCorrection: Add a shared era formatter matching modJapaneseDate.FormatBirthDate and use it in list/confirmation displays; retain ISO storage. Add era-boundary/first-year display regression.
findings.originalObservedBehavior: BirthDate rendered directly as ISO yyyy-MM-dd string.
resolutionEvidence: Web.Tests era-boundary and formatter usage regressions

findings.trigger: Open duplicate-confirmation, reset/reload editor, then submit the old confirmation POST.

target.behavior: Reset invalidates pending confirmations and old editor snapshot, then captures a new token with original raw values/version. Reload invalidates pending state and reads a fresh row. ConfirmSave/Delete validate editor identity before domain calls.

findings.requiredCorrection: Invalidate/rotate old editor snapshot on Reset and validate pending editor identity on confirmation POST; keep reload invalidation. Reject old confirmation after reset/reload; add regression.
findings.originalObservedBehavior: Reset keeps snapshot token; Reload removes it; ConfirmSave does not validate the old editor snapshot, so pending confirmation can survive reset/reload.
resolutionEvidence: ConfirmationStore.CancelWhere bound to session and subject
Web adapter stale duplicate confirmation after reset and reload regressions

observedMatches: Birth-era boundaries and strict ISO date parsing
Default search statuses 01/02 and ordinal prefix/name filtering
Integer version overflow protection and optimistic expected-version checks
notRun: Differential runtime comparison between original Access and generated app
Independent reviewer did not execute SQL Server or browser tests; other task reports cover their actual execution

resetReloadDirtyState.observed: Immutable original raw snapshot retained for Reset; explicit Reload reads current row; original baseline survives candidate/error redraw; JS compares current raw values to original baseline.
resetReloadDirtyState.explicitEditViewRouting: Edit action returns View("Edit",model), including invocation from Reload.

foreignKeyCapacityAlignment.conclusion: Physical child nvarchar capacity aligned with parent. CHECK preserves original child capacity; business scalar limits remain separately enforced in C#.

remainingLimitations: Source library references not enumerated by extractor.
Original Access business UI and source-vs-target runtime equivalence are not verified.
Arbitrary third-party ActiveX initialization safety is not established by startup/AutoExec fixtures.

assessment: All four identified findings are resolved by current source and corresponding regression cases. This is a scoped independent static review; it does not establish complete behavioral equivalence with the original Access application.
